preconditions.description: The input is a single string of length between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by exactly one line containing the rearranged string.
If the answer is YES, the output string is a permutation of the input string.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (all(s_out[p-1] == s_out[p*i-1] for p in primes(len(s_out)) for i in range(1, len(s_out)//p + 1)))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the output string satisfies the condition that for every prime p <= length and every i from 1 to length/p, the character at position p equals the character at position p*i.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (not any(s_out[p-1] == s_out[p*i-1] for p in primes(len(s_out)) for i in range(1, len(s_out)//p + 1)) == False)
postconditions.description: If the answer is NO, no permutation of the input string satisfies the required condition.
